title: oberon-vm
$comment: The schema root is intentionally NOT closed: cozystack-engine injects its own keys (_cluster, _namespace) into the values of every tenant application, and with additionalProperties:false Helm rejects the values entirely, so the application does not deploy. No platform chart closes its root. Nested objects are closed: the engine puts nothing there. The memory and hardware defaults and the hardware list must match the machine.yaml passport; the catalog checks verify this.

memory.description: Machine memory: an integer number of Mi or Gi, from 128Mi to 1Gi

hardware.description: Hardware variant: base is Wirth's core as is, chk adds hardware array bounds checking

air.description: Name of an OberonAir in this tenant to join with the radio; empty for none

kubeRole.description: Role of this machine in a Kube cluster: plane or node; empty for none. Needs an air

kubeCluster.description: Name of the Kube cluster, up to 8 characters

kubeNode.description: Name of this node, up to 6 characters (role node)

kubeKey.description: Key of the cluster, up to 16 hex digits; the same on the plane and every node

commands.description: Oberon commands to run at start, separated by ;
